reviewer_issue.source_excerpt:
I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
reviewer_issue.reason: The constraint reports a violation only when a case displacement is greater than DUI. Consequently, a DUI numerically greater than every waterline-case displacement satisfies this query, although it is not the displacement corresponding to the waterline with the greatest displacement. The source requires selection of the greatest displacement, which requires equality with the maximum, not merely absence of a greater case.
reviewer_issue.expected: DUI must be numerically equal, in metric kilotonnes, to the greatest displacement among the waterlines used to determine the UIWL.
reviewer_issue.suggestion: Replace the one-sided greater-than test with a numeric-equality-to-maximum check, while retaining the declared metric-kiloton unit and decimal quantity paths.

reviewer_issue.source_excerpt:
Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.
reviewer_issue.reason: The supplied schema maps hasUpperIceWaterlineCase to upperIceWaterlineCase, but it does not explicitly establish that every waterline used to determine the UIWL is represented by one of these cases. The candidate therefore cannot be confirmed to compute the greatest displacement over the complete source-relevant set; this is a material representation-adequacy question distinct from the confirmed one-sided comparison error.
reviewer_issue.expected: The represented case collection must be established as the complete set of waterlines used for determining the UIWL before the greatest displacement is selected.
reviewer_issue.suggestion: Provide or bind an explicit completeness convention for hasUpperIceWaterlineCase, or add a supplied schema path/constraint that establishes the case collection is exhaustive. Do not infer completeness from the RDFS domain/range alone.

reviewer_issue.reason: The query reports a violation only when a case displacement is greater than DUI. A DUI numerically greater than every represented case displacement therefore passes, although it is not numerically equal to the displacement of the waterline having the greatest displacement. The source requires selection of the greatest displacement, so the constraint must enforce numeric equality with the maximum, using the declared quantity value and metric-kilotonne unit paths.
reviewer_issue.expected: DUI must be numerically equal, in metric kilotonnes, to the greatest displacement among the waterlines used for determining the UIWL.
reviewer_issue.suggestion: Replace the one-sided FILTER (?caseValue > ?upperValue) test with a query that rejects DUI unless no represented case has a greater numeric displacement and at least one represented case has numeric displacement equal to DUI, while retaining the supplied quantity paths and unit constraints.
